isc_certifications_sod._note: Simplified model of SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) certification campaigns and Separation of Duties (SoD) policies, following SailPoint's ISC documentation as checked 2026-11-06. Keyword planning rules, the comment rule and the reassignment-reason rule are this course's own settings, not ISC defaults.

certification.admin_fallback: an org admin chosen at random

concepts.manager campaign: A certification campaign in which each identity's manager reviews all of that identity's access; identities without a manager are left out.
concepts.source owner campaign: A certification campaign in which the owner of one or more sources reviews the accounts and access on those sources.
concepts.search campaign: A certification campaign whose contents come from a search query: identities, access items, uncorrelated accounts or machine accounts, with a reviewer you choose.
concepts.role composition campaign: A certification campaign in which the role owner confirms what a role contains and who it is assigned to, rather than reviewing people.
concepts.sign-off: The reviewer's final step that submits all decisions in a certification; revocations are processed after it.
concepts.remediation: The work that removes revoked access: a provisioning task for a direct-connected source or a manual task for a flat-file source, then verified.
concepts.SoD policy: A Separation of Duties rule made of two access lists; a human identity that holds access from both lists is in violation.
concepts.violation owner: The person or governance group responsible for resolving violations of one SoD policy.
